Slice 4 real-app proof — exact navigation and integrated polish
docs/plans/active/global-overview-workspaces.md, slice 4 items 1-2 and 5

Isolation (verified with `./scripts/tmux-drive.sh paths` before the run):
  run dir       /private/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501
  inner tmux    /private/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501/tmux/tmux-501/default
  state home    /private/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501/state
  config        /private/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501/config/config.json
  SIDECAR_ISOLATED_STATE=1; outer server on -L sidecar-drive.
The machine's default tmux server was never started, stopped, or sent a command.

Fixture (built under the run dir, never in a real repository):
  alpha, beta, gamma — three configured Git projects, each with one commit
  alpha: linked worktree .../worktrees/alpha/feature  (branch feature)
  beta:  linked worktree .../worktrees/beta/feature   (branch feature)
  => two worktrees whose display name is "feature", in different projects
  gamma: main worktree only
  No shells, no agents: every row is a plain workspace, which is exactly the
  kind of row the catalog gained in slice 2 and the kind Enter had to learn to
  open in slice 4.

Reproduce:
  go build -o /tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501-bin ./cmd/sidecar
  export SIDECAR_DRIVE_RUN_DIR=/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501
  export SIDECAR_BIN=/tmp/sidecar-drive-slice4-501-bin
  export SIDECAR_DRIVE_REPO=<run dir>/fixture/alpha
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh paths      # confirm both axes are private first
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh start 200 50

Wide run (200x50), keys in order:
  (launch)          01-startup-project              project space, no global work
  K                 02-global-agents                Sidecar / Overview, [Agents][Workspaces]
  2                 03-global-workspaces-wide       list + one read-only preview box
  / feature         04-global-filter                "2 of 5", both duplicate names
  Down              05-filter-selected-beta         preview follows the exact row (beta)
  Enter Enter       06-opened-beta-feature          accept filter, then open:
                                                    header "Sidecar / feature [feature]",
                                                    project Workspaces focused, the
                                                    beta/feature row selected — not its
                                                    neighbour, and no agent started
  K                 07-return-state-intact          the tab came back with "/ feature",
                                                    "2 of 5", and the same selection

Narrow run (62x26), restarted:
  K 2               12-narrow-62-list               full-width list, two-line rows
  Up Right          13-narrow-62-fullpreview        full-width read-only preview
  Enter             14-narrow-opened-from-preview   Enter means "open" in both layouts
  K Left Up Right   16-selected-beta-main           back in the browser, beta's main
  Enter             17-same-project-open-beta-main  opened beta's main worktree exactly

Read-only check after the run:
  git status --porcelain in alpha, beta, gamma: empty
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh panes: "(no sidecar-created panes)" — browsing started
  no session, attached to nothing, and typed at nothing
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh stop: drive session and inner server gone

Not covered here (proved by unit tests instead): a project whose Workspaces
preview has a doc pane open. Building that in the driver needs a live agent
pane and a markdown link click; the behaviour it would show — the owning
selection keeps its restored document, a sibling selection closes the doc
subtree through the plugin's own rule, and no global code touches the layout —
is proved in internal/plugins/workspace/navigated_selection_test.go and
internal/overview/tab_state_test.go.
